div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[1] 终端输入捕获
parseKeypress() 解析 ANSI 转义序列

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[2] 事件分发
Ink Dispatcher 分发 KeyboardEvent
(捕获/冒泡)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[3] TextInput 处理
TextInput/VimTextInput 组件接收按键
(粘贴检测 / 图片粘贴 / 历史导航 / 命令补全)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[4] 输入提交
PromptInput.onSubmit() 触发
REPL 组件接收用户消息

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[5] QueryEngine.submitMessage()
submitMessage(prompt, options)
discoveredSkillNames.clear()
setCwd(cwd)
解析模型和思考配置

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[6] 系统提示词构建
fetchSystemPromptParts()
getSystemPrompt() -- 角色描述/工具说明/环境信息
getUserContext() -- CLAUDE.md 内容/当前日期
getSystemContext() -- Git 分支/状态/最近提交
coordinator 上下文注入 (如启用)
memory-mechanics 提示注入 (如需要)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[7] 用户输入处理
processUserInput()

span.p:
构建 UserMessage
(文本 + 图片 + 粘贴内容)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[8] 持久化 & 确认
recordTranscript() 写入会话存储
flushSessionStorage() 急切刷新
yield buildSystemInitMessage()

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[9] 进入 query() 循环
queryLoop() -- while (true)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A. 预处理
snipCompact (历史裁剪)
microcompact (移除冗余工具结果)
contextCollapse (渐进式折叠)
autoCompact (超阈值时触发压缩)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
B. API 调用
appendSystemContext(systemPrompt)
prependUserContext(messages)
queryModelWithStreaming()
getAnthropicClient()
anthropic.beta.messages.stream(...)
withRetry() 重试包装
流式返回 StreamEvent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
C. 响应处理
assistant 消息 → yield 给调用方
tool_use blocks → 收集
StreamingToolExecutor 即时启动

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D. 工具执行 (如有 tool_use)
toolOrchestration.runTools()
partitionToolCalls()
并发安全工具 → 并行执行 (≤10)
非并发工具 → 串行执行

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
每个工具执行:
Zod 输入验证 → PreToolUse Hook
→ 权限检查 (规则/分类器/交互)
→ tool.call() 实际执行
→ PostToolUse Hook
→ 结果映射 + 大结果存盘

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
E. 后处理
handleStopHooks()
checkTokenBudget()
getAttachmentMessages()
maxTurns 检查

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: F. 继续决策

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[10] 结果收集
addToTotalSessionCost() 成本累计
recordTranscript() 转录持久化
yield type:result, subtype:success

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[11] UI 渲染
REPL 组件接收 SDKMessage
normalizeMessages() → reorderMessagesInUI()
VirtualMessageList 虚拟滚动渲染
AssistantTextMessage Markdown 渲染
AssistantToolUseMessage 工具调用展示
LogUpdate.diff() → ANSI 差异更新到终端
